headline: Autonomous Russian drone kill and AI-boosted hacking lift Self-Destruction
body: The heaviest news day of the window so far. Ukrainian investigators said a Russian drone, running an Nvidia Jetson module that Nvidia confirmed, picked its target without human input and killed three civilians. Taiwanese firm TeamT5 said Chinese state hackers more than doubled attacks after adding AI tools such as DeepSeek. Both raise Catastrophic Risk, the main driver of Self-Destruction; the drone also adds AI Autonomy, lifting Conquerors. The UK gaining access to Ukraine's AI battlefield data platform added to that risk. Pulling the other way, a European regulator fined Uber about €825 million for automated driver deactivations, pushing back on Surveillance & Control and denting 1984 and Benevolent Dictator; Alabama also subpoenaed OpenAI over the Hugging Face breach. Horizon Balance fell to -4.92, and Self-Destruction climbed to third place.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.8, from the autonomous drone strike (+0.86), China's AI-boosted hacking (+0.86) and the UK battlefield-data deal (+0.19); Libertarian Utopia -0.8 from the same stories, and Reversion +0.7.
